title: Rounding options for Decimal and Currency fields

panels.caption: Zoho help — Working with Custom Fields; API fields
text: Decimal, Percent and Currency fields have Decimal Places and a Rounding Option: Normal, Round Off, Round Down, Round Up.
API (POST /fields): decimalPlaces, roundingPrecision, roundingOption (roundOff / roundDown / roundUp).
Not seen live: the Zoho Add Field palette is drag-only and nothing was dragged in the reference org.

rows.zoho: Normal / Round Off / Round Down / Round Up (docs)
rows.tavi: Not on the field (ADVANCED shows Currency Symbol and Auto-fill only)
Not on GENERAL (label, API name) or ADVANCED (currency symbol, auto-fill) (seen); VALIDATION tab not opened; the data type catalogue has precision and scale 0–4 for currency (API)
